description: Displayed in the Military Museum's open-air weapons park on the Kalemegdan ramparts; the tactical number 17104 falls in the Yugoslav MiG-21bis 17xxx block so this is most likely an L-17; the OpenStreetMap surveyor recorded only MiG-21 and no sub-variant so the variant field is left blank rather than guessed; served Yugoslavia
aliases: MiG21; MiG-21bis; L-17; Fishbed; MiG21bis; L17
